newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI BUYS U.S. MINING EQUIPMENT FIRM.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI BUYS U.S. MINING EQUIPMENT FIRM.

text.p: Australian National Industries (ANI) said on Thursday it had agreed to buy Excel Mining Systems, a U.S.-based manufacturer and distributor of mine roof support systems, for US$22 million.
Excel, which has annual sales of about US$80 million, would be incorporated into ANI Strata Products, a division of ANI Resources and Rail group.
Excel has six plants in the United States which manufacture coal mine roof bolts and plates.
ANI said the North American coal and metalliferous underground mining markets offered signficant potential for ANI Strata products' broader product range.

"This acquisition will allow ANI Strata Products to achieve a global presence in this market and further strengthen its relationships with the major international mining houses by having established manufacturing plants close to major mining areas," ANI managing Director Peter Stancliffe said in a statement.
